items.text: Choosing between MTech, MS, GATE preparation or a job after BTech in ECE, EEE or CSE depends on the work you want, the cost you can carry and the evidence from live notices, not on what your batchmates are doing.
Research and core design roles favour postgraduate study, while many software roles value projects and experience more than another degree.
GATE eligibility, MS admission rules, funding and public sector recruitment conditions change.
